name: Setting Detail
description:
# Retrieve a Setting:

Make GET request to this resource to retrieve a single setting
record containing the following fields:

* `OPA_HOST`: The hostname used to connect to the OPA server. If empty, policy enforcement will be disabled. (string)
* `OPA_PORT`: The port used to connect to the OPA server. Defaults to 8181. (integer)
* `OPA_SSL`: Enable or disable the use of SSL to connect to the OPA server. Defaults to false. (boolean)
* `OPA_AUTH_TYPE`: The authentication type that will be used to connect to the OPA server: "None", "Token", or "Certificate". (choice)
    - `None`
    - `Token`
    - `Certificate`
* `OPA_AUTH_TOKEN`: The token for authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Token". If an authorization header is defined in OPA_AUTH_CUSTOM_HEADERS, it will be overridden by OPA_AUTH_TOKEN. (string)
* `OPA_AUTH_CLIENT_CERT`: The content of the client certificate file for mTLS authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Certificate". (string)
* `OPA_AUTH_CLIENT_KEY`: The content of the client key for mTLS authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Certificate". (string)
* `OPA_AUTH_CA_CERT`: The content of the CA certificate for mTLS authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Certificate". (string)
* `OPA_AUTH_CUSTOM_HEADERS`: Optional custom headers included in requests to the OPA server. Defaults to empty dictionary ({}). (nested object)
* `OPA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`: The number of seconds after which the connection to the OPA server will time out. Defaults to 1.5 seconds. (float)
* `OPA_REQUEST_RETRIES`: The number of retry attempts for connecting to the OPA server. Default is 2. (integer)





# Update a Setting:

Make a PUT or PATCH request to this resource to update this
setting.  The following fields may be modified:


* `OPA_HOST`: The hostname used to connect to the OPA server. If empty, policy enforcement will be disabled. (string, default=`""`)
* `OPA_PORT`: The port used to connect to the OPA server. Defaults to 8181. (integer, default=`8181`)
* `OPA_SSL`: Enable or disable the use of SSL to connect to the OPA server. Defaults to false. (boolean, default=`False`)
* `OPA_AUTH_TYPE`: The authentication type that will be used to connect to the OPA server: "None", "Token", or "Certificate". (choice)
    - `None` (default)
    - `Token`
    - `Certificate`
* `OPA_AUTH_TOKEN`: The token for authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Token". If an authorization header is defined in OPA_AUTH_CUSTOM_HEADERS, it will be overridden by OPA_AUTH_TOKEN. (string, default=`""`)
* `OPA_AUTH_CLIENT_CERT`: The content of the client certificate file for mTLS authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Certificate". (string, default=`""`)
* `OPA_AUTH_CLIENT_KEY`: The content of the client key for mTLS authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Certificate". (string, default=`""`)
* `OPA_AUTH_CA_CERT`: The content of the CA certificate for mTLS authentication to the OPA server. Required when OPA_AUTH_TYPE is "Certificate". (string, default=`""`)
* `OPA_AUTH_CUSTOM_HEADERS`: Optional custom headers included in requests to the OPA server. Defaults to empty dictionary ({}). (nested object, default=`{}`)
* `OPA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`: The number of seconds after which the connection to the OPA server will time out. Defaults to 1.5 seconds. (float, default=`1.5`)
* `OPA_REQUEST_RETRIES`: The number of retry attempts for connecting to the OPA server. Default is 2. (integer, default=`2`)






For a PUT request, include **all** fields in the request.



For a PATCH request, include only the fields that are being modified.



# Delete a Setting:

Make a DELETE request to this resource to delete this setting.
